title: The CycleMin seam forces incoming OE and a thin backward corridor that cannot join the launch
statement: Every CycleMin cycle has incoming run OE (not merely last letter E), the backward entry corridor is a thin scale-restricted tree with a_{-2}<=2 and no three consecutive OOE, and intersecting that tree with the forward launch corridor produces a cyclic obstruction that is not last-even / oo_suffix / F2(v)>v / 2048<2187 / realized (2,1) and that makes some run-survivor infeasible.
counterexamples: trailing EE is CycleMin-legal: n(n^2+n+1) even-even two-step preimages, all of scale n^4
isolated-E a_e=1 is oo_suffix_threshold at the last valley versus the last-even cell
all 99 Proposition 4.9 points remain composition-feasible; 2048<2187 is the suffix dual of 243<256
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / CycleMin entry corridor
notes: Phase 0 only. Isolated-E last run OE is a REPARAMETERIZATION of oo_suffix_threshold plus last-even. Trailing EE opens B_n. No K=11, no 1054k, no L=55293, no floor raise, no finance reopen. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: n=10^6+1; O^a E for a<=4; EE closed form; one-block pullback; (2,1) witness 12915515; 99 lattice points; three-OOE envelope 2048/2187
